name: s91-quality-gate-leftover-not-waited-for
notes: A check that finishes (after 0.5s) but leaves a process that ignores SIGTERM. Ending the check's process group after a normal exit cost a 3s grace on every such check — and killed build servers (VBCSCompiler) that keep the next build warm. The group is killed only on timeout now; output goes to a file, so the leftover can't hold the hook.
